description: This file defines the AdvancedValueBinder class, which extends DefaultValueBinder and implements IValueBinder for handling cell value binding with advanced parsing and formatting in PhpSpreadsheet.

classes.name: AdvancedValueBinder
classes.description: A class that extends DefaultValueBinder to provide advanced cell value binding and formatting capabilities in PhpSpreadsheet.

methods.name: bindValue
methods.description: Binds a value to a cell with advanced parsing for booleans, fractions, percentages, currency, time, datetime, and text wrapping.

methods.name: setImproperFraction
methods.description: Converts an improper fraction string to a numeric value and sets the cell's number format accordingly.

methods.name: setProperFraction
methods.description: Converts a proper fraction string to a numeric value and sets the cell's number format accordingly.

methods.name: setPercentage
methods.description: Converts a percentage string to a decimal and applies percentage formatting.

methods.name: setCurrency
methods.description: Sets a numeric value with currency formatting based on the currency code.

methods.name: setTimeHoursMinutes
methods.description: Converts a time string (hours:minutes) to a numeric value with time formatting.

methods.name: setTimeHoursMinutesSeconds
methods.description: Converts a time string (hours:minutes:seconds) to a numeric value with time formatting.
